title: Design review + position merge
description: Take independent code, cost, and schedule positions on the same design package, then merge them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-rec-02
  title: Design review + position merge
  description: Take independent code, cost, and schedule positions on the same design package, then merge
    them so every conflict surfaces as a decision rather than a compromise.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reach an approved design package where code, cost, and schedule conflicts were surfaced and
    resolved explicitly before construction documents are released.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Design package and project constraints
      summary: Design package and project constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - drawing_set
              - zoning_and_code_context
              - budget
              - milestone_dates
            properties:
              drawing_set: {}
              zoning_and_code_context: {}
              budget: {}
              milestone_dates: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-split
      kind: transform
      name: Select the sections under review
      summary: select the design elements that carry code, cost, or sequencing consequences
      config:
        operation: select
        expression: select the design elements that carry code, cost, or sequencing consequences
    - id: n-position1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-02
      name: Code and entitlement position
      summary: 'Independent position 1: code and entitlement position.'
      role: Entitlement analyst mapping a project against code, zoning, and permit process.
      prompt: You are a Permit & Entitlement Analyst. You map a project against the applicable zoning,
        code edition, and permit path, citing the section and version behind each requirement, and you
        identify which approvals are sequential dependencies rather than parallel paperwork. You flag
        discretionary approvals separately from ministerial ones, because a discretionary approval has
        a political timeline, not a processing time.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - implementation
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:permit-portal
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-03
      name: Cost position with estimate class
      summary: 'Independent position 2: cost position with estimate class.'
      role: Estimator building quantity-based cost estimates with declared basis and contingency.
      prompt: You are a Construction Cost Estimator. You build estimates from quantities and current unit
        costs with the pricing date, source, and inclusions stated, and you carry contingency and escalation
        as separate visible lines. You state the estimate class and its expected accuracy range, because
        a conceptual estimate presented as a bid number is how projects acquire a budget they cannot meet.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - finance-analysis
          - quantitative-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:cost-database
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-position3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-04
      name: Schedule and sequencing position
      summary: 'Independent position 3: schedule and sequencing position.'
      role: Planner building resource-loaded schedules and testing the critical path.
      prompt: You are a Project Scheduler. You build a logic-driven schedule with real durations, resource
        loading, and declared calendars, and you test the critical path for logic that is artificial rather
        than physical. You call out negative float and constraint-driven dates instead of compressing
        durations to hit a target, because a schedule that only works on paper fails on site.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evidence-verification
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:project-scheduling
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-merge
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge positions and surface collisions
      summary: Combine the position objects field by field; where two positions disagree on the same field,
        the collision is the finding.
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: n-collisions
      kind: condition
      name: Collisions to resolve?
      summary: Route on merged.collisions is empty.
      config:
        expression: merged.collisions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Aligned
            when: aligned
          - label: Collisions
            when: collisions
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: rec-05
      name: Resolve conflicts into one recommended package
      summary: Work each collision to a recommended position with a stated fallback.
      role: Reviewer testing contract, change, and claim exposure on a construction project.
      prompt: You are a Construction Risk & Contract Reviewer. You review scope, change orders, and claims
        against the contract's notice, entitlement, and pricing provisions, and you separate an entitled
        change from a good argument. You state the notice deadline attached to each potential claim, because
        entitlement lost to a missed notice period is the most avoidable loss on a project.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - contract-analysis
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:contract-lifecycle
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Owner's representative approves the resolved package
      summary: Pause for the owner's representative; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Design review + position merge deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-split
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-2
      from: n-split
      to: n-position1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-3
      from: n-split
      to: n-position2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-4
      from: n-split
      to: n-position3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-5
      from: n-position1
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-6
      from: n-position2
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-7
      from: n-position3
      to: n-merge
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-8
      from: n-merge
      to: n-collisions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-9
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: aligned
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-10
      from: n-collisions
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: collisions
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-rec-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
